description: In the 7th District of the battleground state of Pennsylvania, Democrats are trying to convince a working-class population that feels abandoned by the Trump administration to vote for them.

description: Spurred by messages on social media, around 50,000 people illegally crossed into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta since Thursday, July 30, in an unprecedented influx. But most have already been forced to make the journey back.

headline: Argentina's President Milei attempts to reclaim the political spotlight by issuing anti-foreigner decree
description: By announcing a decree targeting foreigners who have 'spread messages of hate' against the Argentine people, particularly during the World Cup, the president is tapping into the country's heightened patriotism in an effort to regain control of the political agenda after weeks away from the public eye.

headline: Trump slams prosecutor for dismissing Reflecting Pool case
description: The US president's plans to renovate Washington's Reflecting Pool this summer created a national drama after a botched installation led to rapid algae growth. Although Trump repeatedly claimed that vandals were responsible, federal prosecutor Jeanine Pirro rejected the accusation, leading the president to publicly lash out on Saturday.

headline: French-American jazz duo DOMi & JD Beck release genre-defying second album
description: Endorsed by Herbie Hancock, DOMi & JD Beck's second album, 'Who Asked?' is hard to label, combining jazz, electro and indie pop, and experimenting with acoustic wind instruments like the clarinet, trombone and flute.

description: Since July 23, 12 people have been referred to court for 'endangering the lives of others,' according to figures from the Bordeaux prosecutor's office, which announced tougher criminal action against the use of fire in forested areas.

headline: Kush, a synthetic and highly addictive drug, devastates Sierra Leone and Liberia
description: 'Africa under the influence' (2/6). Sold at a low price, kush causes rapid addiction and severe, often fatal, injuries. Photographer Gaël Turine traveled to Freetown and Monrovia to document the destruction wrought by this new synthetic drug among young people in Sierra Leone and Liberia.
